name: AnimatedPBR3D
description: Attach custom PBR textures (Albedo, Normal, Roughness, Metalness, AO, Emissive) from project image resources to 3D objects, and animate textures with real-time UV scrolling, flipbook/spritesheet frame animation, UV rotation, and video textures.
author: Christopher Monhollen

eventsBasedBehaviors.description: Controls PBR materials and real-time texture animations (UV scroll, flipbook spritesheet, video) on a 3D object.
eventsBasedBehaviors.name: AnimatedPBR3D

eventsFunctions.name: SetAlbedoTexture
eventsFunctions.description: Set the albedo base color texture from an image resource.

eventsFunctions.name: SetNormalTexture
eventsFunctions.description: Set the normal bump map texture and scale.

eventsFunctions.name: SetRoughnessTexture
eventsFunctions.description: Set the roughness texture map and factor value (0 to 1).

eventsFunctions.name: SetMetalnessTexture
eventsFunctions.description: Set the metalness texture map and factor value (0 to 1).

eventsFunctions.name: SetEmissiveTexture
eventsFunctions.description: Set the emissive glow texture map, color, and strength.
eventsFunctions.sentence: Set emissive map of _PARAM0_ to _PARAM2_ with color _PARAM3_;_PARAM4_;_PARAM5_ (strength: _PARAM6_)

eventsFunctions.name: SetScrollSpeed
eventsFunctions.description: Set the UV scrolling and rotation speeds. This does not switch scrolling on by itself: use "Enable/disable UV scrolling" for that.
eventsFunctions.sentence: Set UV scroll speed of _PARAM0_ to X: _PARAM2_, Y: _PARAM3_ (rotation: _PARAM4_ deg/s)

eventsFunctions.name: EnableScrolling
eventsFunctions.description: Turn UV scrolling animation on or off.

eventsFunctions.name: SetTiling
eventsFunctions.description: Set the horizontal and vertical texture repetition factors.
eventsFunctions.sentence: Set texture tiling of _PARAM0_ to X: _PARAM2_, Y: _PARAM3_

eventsFunctions.name: SetFlipbookConfig
eventsFunctions.description: Configure spritesheet columns, rows, FPS, and loop mode.
eventsFunctions.sentence: Set flipbook animation on _PARAM0_ (columns: _PARAM2_, rows: _PARAM3_, FPS: _PARAM4_, loop: _PARAM5_)

eventsFunctions.name: SetFlipbookFrame
eventsFunctions.description: Jump directly to a specific animation frame index (0-based). This also clears the finished state, so a non-looping animation can be restarted.
eventsFunctions.sentence: Set current flipbook frame of _PARAM0_ to _PARAM2_

eventsFunctions.name: PlayFlipbook
eventsFunctions.description: Resume or start playing the flipbook spritesheet animation.

eventsFunctions.name: PauseFlipbook
eventsFunctions.description: Pause the flipbook spritesheet animation on current frame.

eventsFunctions.name: SetVideoTexture
eventsFunctions.description: Load and play an MP4/WebM video file as the 3D surface texture. The URL is used as-is; for a file inside your project use "Set video texture (from resource)" instead, so the path survives export. Browsers block autoplay unless the video is muted.
eventsFunctions.sentence: Set video texture on _PARAM0_ from URL _PARAM2_ (loop: _PARAM3_, muted: _PARAM4_)

parameters.name: VideoURL
parameters.description: Video URL (http/https, or a path relative to the exported game)

eventsFunctions.name: SetVideoTextureFromResource
eventsFunctions.description: Play a video from the project resources as the 3D surface texture. Unlike the URL version, the path is resolved through the resource loader, so it keeps working after export.
eventsFunctions.sentence: Set video texture on _PARAM0_ from resource _PARAM2_ (loop: _PARAM3_, muted: _PARAM4_)

eventsFunctions.name: PlayVideo
eventsFunctions.description: Play or resume video texture playback.

eventsFunctions.name: PauseVideo
eventsFunctions.description: Pause video texture playback.

eventsFunctions.name: IsFlipbookPlaying
eventsFunctions.description: Check if the flipbook spritesheet animation is currently playing.

eventsFunctions.name: IsFlipbookFinished
eventsFunctions.description: Check if the non-looping flipbook animation reached its last frame.

eventsFunctions.name: IsScrollingEnabled
eventsFunctions.description: Check if UV scrolling is currently active.

eventsFunctions.name: IsMaterialReady
eventsFunctions.description: Check if the 3D material has been successfully initialized.

eventsFunctions.name: CurrentFrame
eventsFunctions.description: Get the current active flipbook frame index (0-based).

eventsFunctions.name: TotalFrames
eventsFunctions.description: Get the total number of frames in the active flipbook animation.

eventsFunctions.name: ScrollOffsetX
eventsFunctions.description: Get the current accumulated horizontal UV scroll offset.

eventsFunctions.name: ScrollOffsetY
eventsFunctions.description: Get the current accumulated vertical UV scroll offset.

eventsFunctions.name: ScrollRotation
eventsFunctions.description: Get the current accumulated UV rotation angle in degrees.

propertyDescriptors.name: ApplyOnCreation
propertyDescriptors.label: Apply On Creation
propertyDescriptors.description: Automatically apply the configured material when the 3D renderer is ready.

propertyDescriptors.name: IncludeChildren
propertyDescriptors.label: Include Children
propertyDescriptors.description: Apply material to all child meshes inside the 3D model.

propertyDescriptors.name: TargetMode
propertyDescriptors.label: Target Mode
propertyDescriptors.description: Which materials inside the 3D object to modify.

propertyDescriptors.name: MaterialIndex
propertyDescriptors.label: Material Index
propertyDescriptors.description: Index of the material to target (when Target Mode is 'Material index').

propertyDescriptors.name: MaterialName
propertyDescriptors.label: Material Name
propertyDescriptors.description: Name of the material to target (when Target Mode is 'Material name').

propertyDescriptors.name: MeshName
propertyDescriptors.label: Mesh Name
propertyDescriptors.description: Name of the mesh to target (when Target Mode is 'Mesh name').

propertyDescriptors.name: CloneMaterials
propertyDescriptors.label: Clone Materials
propertyDescriptors.description: Clone materials so modifications do not affect other object instances.

propertyDescriptors.name: AlbedoMap
propertyDescriptors.label: Albedo / Base Color Map
propertyDescriptors.description: Base color texture image from project resources.

propertyDescriptors.name: UseBaseColor
propertyDescriptors.label: Use Base Color Tint
propertyDescriptors.description: Apply a base color tint over the albedo texture.

propertyDescriptors.name: BaseColor
propertyDescriptors.label: Base Color Tint
propertyDescriptors.description: Base color tint (RGB).

propertyDescriptors.name: NormalMap
propertyDescriptors.label: Normal Map
propertyDescriptors.description: Surface normal bump texture image.

propertyDescriptors.name: NormalScale
propertyDescriptors.label: Normal Map Scale
propertyDescriptors.description: Intensity of the normal map bump effect.

propertyDescriptors.name: RoughnessMap
propertyDescriptors.label: Roughness Map
propertyDescriptors.description: Micro-surface roughness texture image.

propertyDescriptors.name: Roughness
propertyDescriptors.label: Roughness Factor (0-1)
propertyDescriptors.description: Overall surface roughness (0.0 = mirror smooth, 1.0 = rough matte).

propertyDescriptors.name: MetalnessMap
propertyDescriptors.label: Metalness Map
propertyDescriptors.description: Metallic reflection mask texture image.

propertyDescriptors.name: Metalness
propertyDescriptors.label: Metalness Factor (0-1)
propertyDescriptors.description: Overall surface metalness (0.0 = dielectric / wood / stone, 1.0 = metal).

propertyDescriptors.name: AOMap
propertyDescriptors.label: Ambient Occlusion (AO) Map
propertyDescriptors.description: Ambient occlusion crevice shadow map image.

propertyDescriptors.name: AOIntensity
propertyDescriptors.label: AO Intensity (0-1)
propertyDescriptors.description: Strength of the ambient occlusion shadow darkening.

propertyDescriptors.name: EmissiveMap
propertyDescriptors.label: Emissive Map
propertyDescriptors.description: Glow / self-illumination mask texture image.

propertyDescriptors.name: EmissiveColor
propertyDescriptors.label: Emissive Color
propertyDescriptors.description: Color of the self-illuminating glow.

propertyDescriptors.name: EmissiveStrength
propertyDescriptors.label: Emissive Strength
propertyDescriptors.description: Intensity of the emissive glow.

propertyDescriptors.name: TextureFiltering
propertyDescriptors.label: Texture Filtering
propertyDescriptors.description: Pixel interpolation filtering mode.

propertyDescriptors.name: TilingX
propertyDescriptors.label: Tiling X (Repeat)
propertyDescriptors.description: Horizontal texture repetition multiplier.

propertyDescriptors.name: TilingY
propertyDescriptors.label: Tiling Y (Repeat)
propertyDescriptors.description: Vertical texture repetition multiplier.

propertyDescriptors.name: OffsetX
propertyDescriptors.label: Offset X
propertyDescriptors.description: Base horizontal UV offset.

propertyDescriptors.name: OffsetY
propertyDescriptors.label: Offset Y
propertyDescriptors.description: Base vertical UV offset.

propertyDescriptors.name: RotationAngle
propertyDescriptors.label: UV Rotation (Degrees)
propertyDescriptors.description: Texture rotation angle in degrees.

propertyDescriptors.name: RotationCenterX
propertyDescriptors.label: Rotation Center X
propertyDescriptors.description: Pivot point X for texture rotation (0.5 = center).

propertyDescriptors.name: RotationCenterY
propertyDescriptors.label: Rotation Center Y
propertyDescriptors.description: Pivot point Y for texture rotation (0.5 = center).

propertyDescriptors.name: EnableScroll
propertyDescriptors.label: Enable UV Scrolling
propertyDescriptors.description: Continuously animate UV offset and rotation every frame (e.g. lava, water, conveyor).

propertyDescriptors.name: ScrollSpeedX
propertyDescriptors.label: Scroll Speed X
propertyDescriptors.description: Horizontal scrolling speed (UV units per second).

propertyDescriptors.name: ScrollSpeedY
propertyDescriptors.label: Scroll Speed Y
propertyDescriptors.description: Vertical scrolling speed (UV units per second).

propertyDescriptors.name: ScrollRotationSpeed
propertyDescriptors.label: Rotation Speed (deg/sec)
propertyDescriptors.description: Texture rotation speed (degrees per second).

propertyDescriptors.name: EnableFlipbook
propertyDescriptors.label: Enable Flipbook Animation
propertyDescriptors.description: Animate the texture across a 2D spritesheet grid of frames (e.g. animated faces, screens).

propertyDescriptors.name: FlipbookColumns
propertyDescriptors.label: Flipbook Columns (X frames)
propertyDescriptors.description: Number of horizontal frames in the spritesheet.

propertyDescriptors.name: FlipbookRows
propertyDescriptors.label: Flipbook Rows (Y frames)
propertyDescriptors.description: Number of vertical frames in the spritesheet.

propertyDescriptors.name: FlipbookFPS
propertyDescriptors.label: Animation FPS
propertyDescriptors.description: Playback frame rate (frames per second).

propertyDescriptors.name: FlipbookLoop
propertyDescriptors.label: Loop Animation
propertyDescriptors.description: Loop the spritesheet animation continuously.

propertyDescriptors.name: FlipbookTotalFrames
propertyDescriptors.label: Total Frames (0 = all)
propertyDescriptors.description: Total frames in animation sequence (0 uses Columns * Rows).

propertyDescriptors.name: AlphaMode
propertyDescriptors.label: Alpha Mode
propertyDescriptors.description: Transparency and alpha blending mode.

propertyDescriptors.name: Alpha
propertyDescriptors.label: Alpha Opacity (0-1)
propertyDescriptors.description: Overall opacity transparency (for Blend mode).

propertyDescriptors.name: AlphaCutoff
propertyDescriptors.label: Alpha Cutoff (Cutout Mode)
propertyDescriptors.description: Alpha threshold for Cutout mode.

propertyDescriptors.name: DepthWrite
propertyDescriptors.label: Depth Write
propertyDescriptors.description: Write to depth buffer (disable for transparent overlays/particles).

propertyDescriptors.name: MaterialSide
propertyDescriptors.label: Material Side
propertyDescriptors.description: Render front faces, back faces, or double sided.

propertyDescriptors.name: Wireframe
propertyDescriptors.label: Wireframe
propertyDescriptors.description: Render polygon mesh wireframe.

propertyDescriptors.name: CastShadow
propertyDescriptors.label: Cast Shadow
propertyDescriptors.description: Object casts shadows from directional/point lights.

propertyDescriptors.name: ReceiveShadow
propertyDescriptors.label: Receive Shadow
propertyDescriptors.description: Object receives shadows cast by other objects.

shortDescription: Custom PBR textures on 3D objects, animated with UV scrolling, flipbook spritesheets and video.
